canonical_title: Fuel, oil, and coolant filler openings

amendments.title_at_amendment: Fuel, oil, and coolant filler openings.
amendments.text:
The following information shall be marked on or adjacent to the

filler cover in each case: (a) The word "fuel," the minimum permissible fuel octane number for the engines installed, and the usable fuel tank capacity. (See § 3.437.) (b) The word "oil" and the oil tank capacity. (c) The name of the proper coolant fluid and the capacity of the coolant system.
